2577-7084-7272-8345.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-7084-7272-8345.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
2577-7084-7272-8345.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

339-574-677-6633.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
339-574-677-6633.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

719-5414-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
719-5414-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability, preventing the next 2 damage dealt to a target this turn.
Repeat from step 3.

1981-2415-4247-5931.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Funeral Room and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1379-2921-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
1379-2921-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter as an artifact land creature due to Encroaching Mycosynth and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 2 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Bartolomé del Presidio.

553-1542-4586.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
553-1542-4586.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Wizards of Thay.
In response, cast Endless Detour by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

104-2685-3197-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-2685-3197-7810.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

240-5470-6797-7297.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

814-1251-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
814-1251-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Myrel as attackers.
Myrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2762-4659-6291.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Thopter Squadron's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Thopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

893-4853-5226.description:
Activate Myr Turbine by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the Myr.
When the Myr dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Myr Turbine.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

57-1879-4235-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-1879-4235-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

57-283-4846-4927.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{R}.
57-283-4846-4927.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

522-2511-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Melira.
When Melira dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

64-972-2792.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
64-972-2792.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is an artifact.
When the Great Whale token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Warden of the Eye by paying its mana cost.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Warden of the Eye and the Great Whale token.
When the Warden of the Eye and Great Whale tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat from step 6.
64-972-2792.notes: If the seven lands can tap to produce {5}{U}{U} or more, this combo will net infinite mana. So long as you produce an extra {U} each loop, you can eventually stop copying Great Whale and copy other creature(s) or artifact(s) instead. You can also create two copies of Warden of the Eye instead to return other applicable cards to your hand.

339-647-677-997.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4050-4770-6090-6705.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat and a 1/1 Frog creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Cat and Frog, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

1049-2440-4871-6798.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{W}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable, or an additional {R}, {W} or {B} if you haven't cast Jirina from the command zone this game
1049-2440-4871-6798.description:
Cast Jirina from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{W}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Jirina enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Jirina trigger, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token for each time you've cast Jirina from the command zone this game.
When the Human Soldiers enter the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Human and Soldier you control.
Repeat step 5 for each remaining Mana Echoes trigger created in steps 2 and 4.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Jirina and a Human Soldier.
Choose to return Jirina to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Jirina and the Human Soldier die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Holding priority, if you control a Human Soldier, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a Human Soldier.
If you sacrificed a Human Soldier this way, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from steps 7 and 10, putting three +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate up to three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding any combination of {R}, {W} and {B}.
Repeat.

321-877-2475-6707.description:
Cast Hibernation Sliver by paying {0} due to Morophon.
Hibernation Sliver enters the battlefield, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Hibernation Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1652-2510-5626.notablePrerequisites:
There is an enchantment card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
You have at least {E}{E}{E}.
You have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
1652-2510-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Patron of the Arts and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Patron of the Arts dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Patron of the Arts from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1636-3692.notablePrerequisites: You control creatures that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}.
1636-3692.description:
Activate mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}.
Cast Aethersnipe for its evoke cost by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Aethersnipe enters the battlefield, both of its abilities trigger and Intruder Alarm triggers; put the evoke trigger on the stack first.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Aethersnipe's first ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve Aethersnipe's evoke trigger, failing to sacrifice it since it is not on the battlefield.
Repeat.

224-2026-3470-4967.notablePrerequisites: Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
224-2026-3470-4967.description:
Activate Thawing Glaciers by paying {1} and tapping it, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm and Lotus Cobra.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Thawing Glaciers.
Repeat.

2815-4891-5184-5220-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Atsushi, adding {R}.
Atsushi dies, triggering itself and Mortuary.
Resolve the Atsushi trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, causing you to put Atsushi on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Professional Face-Breaker by sacrificing a Treasure, exiling Atsushi from the top of your library and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Activate the three remaining Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}.
Cast Atsushi from exile by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1135-1738.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
1135-1738.description:
Cast Kazuul's Fury by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing Serra Avatar, dealing damage equal to Serra Avatar's power to target opponent with a life total equal to or less than your life total.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

1055-1074-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to King Macar.
King Macar does not have summoning sickness.
1055-1074-3525.description:
Activate King Macar by tapping it, causing a player to mill cards equal to King Macar's toughness.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping King Macar.
King Macar triggers, exiling any opposing creature and creating a Gold token.
Activate the Gold token by sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1987-2427-2556-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
